scientific_integrity: The eight-residue law and finite-knot envelope are claimed; the general full-diagonal sharpness theorem and 15/64 continuous benchmark are acknowledged as published. Finite script checks corroborate, but do not prove, unbounded-n statements.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns nonnegative finite checkerboard arrays, diagonal grid knots, and grid-point asymmetry; neither strictly positive maximizers nor off-grid maximal asymmetry are asserted. The sharp continuous-diagonal upper bound and diagonal splice are prior results invoked explicitly.
title: Exact eight-residue law for asymmetry invisible to diagonal-grid independence
